relations: Red track rails wind around black supports and yellow hubs mounted on wooden stair treads.
A metallic marble rolls down the upper-left descending curve of the tight spiral.
As the camera tilts upward, the spiral exits view, revealing a horizontal loop near the top landing.
Stairs, balusters, and supports remain fixed relative to one another during the camera motion.
caption: The video showcases a red marble-run track mounted along a wooden staircase and beige wall, held by black post-and-wheel supports, yellow and white hubs, and small wooden blocks on the treads. A single metallic marble rolls along the rails while the camera steadily tilts upward. Early frames center on a tight spiral wrapped around a vertical column, the marble traveling down the upper-left descending curve. As the column slides out of view, the framing brings a horizontal loop near the top landing into focus, where the marble is seen circling. The stairs, balusters, and supports stay fixed relative to one another, their shifting positions arising from camera motion rather than object movement.
